question.text: The correct statement with respect to dinitrogen is:

options.text: it can combine with dioxygen at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>25</mn><mo>°</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math>
liquid dinitrogen is not used in cryosurgery.
it can be used as an inert diluent for reactive chemicals

solution.text:
(1) liquid dinitrogen is used in cryosurgery.

(2) N2 is diamagnetic in nature.

(3) it can not combine with dioxygen at 25ºC.

(4) is correct
